name: Neighbors
overview: Scripture commands believers to love their neighbors as themselves, emphasizing this as a fundamental and unparalleled commandment (Leviticus 19:18; Mark 12:31; Luke 10:27). Loving neighbors involves actively refraining from harm or evil intentions toward them and instead practicing kindness and care (Proverbs 3:29; Romans 13:10). The principle of treating others as we would want to be treated encapsulates the heart of this teaching and fulfills the law (Matthew 7:12; Romans 13:10).
